claimBoundary: Target/evidence requirements only. No current pass/fail state. This contract cannot promote ICTC to Enterprise Candidate or Enterprise Ready.

experienceLattice.sees: host, network, runtime identity, keys, databases, object stores and deployment boundaries
experienceLattice.mustBeTrue: The mounted environment cannot silently impersonate stronger custody, provenance, isolation or recovery than externally observed.
experienceLattice.failureIfBroken: deployment substrate can falsify every higher-layer assurance claim
experienceLattice.evidenceBoundary: repository contracts are E2; effective host/key/network controls remain E4 where declared

experienceLattice.sees: transaction, subject version, command replay, persistence, blob and recovery semantics
experienceLattice.mustBeTrue: Accepted writes, versions, tenant boundaries and recovery semantics remain deterministic under the declared topology.
experienceLattice.failureIfBroken: higher-level work can be lost, duplicated, cross-tenant or historically ambiguous
experienceLattice.evidenceBoundary: repository implementation can be E2; production recovery/load effectiveness is E4

experienceLattice.sees: upstream identity, proxy trust, role mapping, tenancy, secrets and revocation boundary
experienceLattice.mustBeTrue: No client-visible token/header or local convenience path can silently grant enterprise identity, tenancy or secret authority.
experienceLattice.failureIfBroken: human attribution and authorization become non-reliable
experienceLattice.evidenceBoundary: mapping/deny semantics may be E2; IdP/MFA/revocation effectiveness is E4

experienceLattice.sees: HTTP contract, handler registry, semantic runtime, projections, writes, receipts and error envelopes
experienceLattice.mustBeTrue: One business/epistemic contract governs local and enterprise adapters and every material write is authorized, bounded and read back.
experienceLattice.failureIfBroken: parallel business truth or optimistic UI can emerge

experienceLattice.sees: provider choice, purpose, information class, network boundary, budget, schema, trace and rollback gate
experienceLattice.mustBeTrue: AI remains proposal-only, export eligibility precedes transport and activation is version/eval/drift bounded.
experienceLattice.failureIfBroken: information leakage, model-result authority or unbounded drift can occur
experienceLattice.evidenceBoundary: repository controls are E2; provider/deployment effectiveness is separately evidenced

experienceLattice.sees: candidate SHA, CI gates, dependencies, SBOM, provenance, signature, review and rollback
experienceLattice.mustBeTrue: A candidate is attributable to exact source/input/output and merge is not release or Enterprise Candidate.
experienceLattice.failureIfBroken: green CI can be laundered into provenance or governed release
experienceLattice.evidenceBoundary: repository provenance/signing predicates are E2; server-side review enforcement is E3-GOV

experienceLattice.sees: health, request correlation, telemetry ports, capacity envelope, alerts, backup and recovery drills
experienceLattice.mustBeTrue: Failures are attributable and operational limits remain explicit under real deployment load/failure conditions.
experienceLattice.failureIfBroken: repository health can be confused with service effectiveness
experienceLattice.evidenceBoundary: local instrumentation is E2; production collector/SLO/soak/restore effectiveness is E4

experienceLattice.sees: users/roles, procedure policy, environment, AI provider/budget/egress and readiness blockers
experienceLattice.mustBeTrue: Administration exposes material policy truth and effects without granting hidden business, identity or deployment authority.
experienceLattice.failureIfBroken: configuration can become an invisible authority escalation or misleading readiness signal
experienceLattice.evidenceBoundary: runtime/admin behavior is E2; enterprise identity/governance effectiveness remains external

experienceLattice.sees: seven native procedures, next work, source/event/object/standard/action/risk/assurance state and human checkpoints
experienceLattice.mustBeTrue: Observed, proposed, decided, mapped, completed and verified states never collapse and cross-process handoffs restart native checkpoints.
experienceLattice.failureIfBroken: workflow completion can masquerade as legal/compliance conclusion
experienceLattice.evidenceBoundary: business/runtime semantics are E2; substantive legal truth remains outside ICTC

experienceLattice.sees: decision basis, versions, actor, receipts, evidence graph, integrity and explicit limitations
experienceLattice.mustBeTrue: The auditor can reconstruct what ICTC recorded and why without treating software integrity, internal approval or mapping as independent assurance.
experienceLattice.failureIfBroken: traceability becomes confidence theatre rather than bounded evidence
experienceLattice.evidenceBoundary: repository evidence is E2; independent review is E3 where required

experienceLattice.sees: identity, one primary decision/work item, bounded priorities/registers, context/evidence and technical detail in that order
experienceLattice.mustBeTrue: The first plane minimizes competing salience, card walls and unbounded lists while preserving semantic state, actor, limitation and human veto.
experienceLattice.failureIfBroken: the interface can be formally correct but cognitively mislead or overload the person
experienceLattice.evidenceBoundary: DOM/browser/order checks are E2; comprehension, efficiency, trust calibration and assistive-technology effectiveness require E3-HUMAN

experienceLattice.sees: representative-user evidence, GitHub/server governance and real deployment evidence kept separate from repository claims
experienceLattice.mustBeTrue: Missing E3-HUMAN, E3-GOV or E4-DEPLOY stays visibly missing and can never be synthesized from CI, mutation count or documentation.
experienceLattice.evidenceBoundary: E3-HUMAN, E3-GOV and E4-DEPLOY are external rails by definition

experienceLatticeOrder: iron -> durable data -> identity -> runtime/API -> AI -> delivery -> operations -> administration -> domain work -> audit/evidence -> end-user cognition -> external assurance
experienceLatticeClaimBoundary: The lattice defines what Enterprise Candidate must remain coherent for each human perspective. It stores no current pass/fail state and cannot close E3-HUMAN, E3-GOV or E4-DEPLOY.
